# Book vacation rentals direct. Skip the fees.

StayThere is the Zillow of short-term rental direct booking. We index 95,000+ vacation rentals from independent host sites onto one searchable map — find your stay here, then book straight with the host. No middleman, no Airbnb service fee, no surprise charges at checkout.

## Why book direct on StayThere?

Online travel agencies like Airbnb and VRBO charge guests a service fee that averages around 14% of the booking subtotal — on a $1,000 rental that's $140 added at checkout, on top of cleaning fees and taxes. StayThere connects you directly to the host's own booking system, so none of that applies. The price shown is what the host charges.

- No Airbnb service fee — guests pay the host's real rate, not an OTA-inflated price.

- 95,000+ listings — aggregated from thousands of independent property manager and host direct booking sites.

- Map-based search — browse by location, dates, price, bedrooms, and guest count in one interactive map.

- Instant availability — live calendar data synced from hosts' booking systems.

- Stripe-secured payments — all transactions on StayThere use Stripe's enterprise-grade payment processing.

## How StayThere works

### For guests looking to book a vacation rental

Search your destination on the StayThere explore map . Filter by check-in and check-out dates, number of guests, price range, and number of bedrooms. Click any listing to see full details, photos, and pricing. Then click through to the host's direct booking page and complete your reservation — no middleman, no markup.

### For vacation rental hosts and property managers

List your vacation rental on StayThere and get discovered by guests looking to book direct. Import listings from Guesty, Hospitable, Hostaway, Lodgify, or Ownerrez, or add them manually. Your properties appear on the explore map. Guests click through to your own site and book directly — you keep 100% of the nightly rate with no OTA commission deducted.

## StayThere vs. Airbnb vs. VRBO

Airbnb and VRBO are online travel agencies (OTAs) — they sit between guests and hosts, charging both sides a fee. Airbnb charges guests up to 14% and hosts up to 3%. VRBO charges similar amounts. StayThere is a direct booking search platform: we surface the inventory and connect guests to the host's own booking system. No platform fee, no middleman cut.

## Frequently asked questions about StayThere

### What is StayThere?

StayThere (staythere.ai) is a vacation rental direct booking platform. It aggregates 95,000+ listings from independent host and property manager websites onto one searchable map, letting travelers compare real prices and book direct — without Airbnb or VRBO service fees.

### Does StayThere charge a service fee?

No. StayThere does not add a guest service fee. Airbnb charges guests approximately 14% on top of the host rate. On StayThere, you pay the host's nightly rate, cleaning fee, and taxes — nothing more.

### Is StayThere legit and safe?

Yes. Payments on StayThere are processed by Stripe, the same payment infrastructure used by Amazon, Shopify, and millions of businesses. For listings that link out to a host's own site, you complete your reservation on that host's secure checkout page.

### How many vacation rentals are on StayThere?

Over 95,000 vacation rental listings are indexed on StayThere, sourced from direct booking sites across the US and internationally.

### What is the website address for StayThere?

StayThere's website is staythere.ai . Search rentals at staythere.ai/explore or learn about hosting at staythere.ai/about .
